summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive digital museum that brings attention to NASA's discarded space equipment on the Moon and Mars. Our project explores the stories of historic spacecraft, landers, rovers and scientific instruments that contributed to space exploration.

Through an educational website, visitors can explore different space artifacts, discover their missions, understand their scientific contributions and learn what happened to them after their missions ended. The website includes Moon and Mars exploration sections, artifact information, a mission timeline and an interactive quiz.

Our goal is to make space exploration more engaging and understandable, especially for young learners. We want to show that even when a mission ends, the discoveries and contributions of its equipment remain valuable. Every machine has a story worth remembering.
details:
Project Title: Echoes of Exploration – Stories of NASA's Forgotten Machines

Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational digital museum that tells the stories of NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars.

Our project allows visitors to explore different space artifacts, learn about their missions, understand their scientific contributions and discover what happened to them after their missions ended.

The website is designed with different sections, including Explore the Moon, Explore Mars, Artifact Stories, Mission Timeline and an Interactive Quiz. Users can explore artifact information and learn about the history of space exploration in a simple and engaging way.

We are developing this project as an educational website using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Its purpose is to make space science more interesting and accessible, especially for young learners.

The creative idea behind our project is to present abandoned space equipment not as forgotten objects, but as important parts of humanity's journey into space. Even when a mission ends, its discoveries continue to inspire future exploration.
